strategy.name: Halal Gold (PAXG/XAUT) VWAP + RSI(3) + EMA(8) + MACD Spot Strategy

shariah_compliance.notes: This strategy only takes long (buy) positions on spot markets. Short selling is prohibited because it involves selling assets not in one's possession. Leverage and margin are prohibited due to riba (interest). Only Shariah-screened assets are traded.

strategy.description: Trading tokenized physical gold (PAXG = Pax Gold, XAUT = Tether Gold). Each token is backed 1:1 by a troy ounce of physical gold — the most Shariah-sound digital asset class. Four indicators: EMA(8) for trend direction, VWAP for session bias, RSI(3) for entry timing, MACD for momentum confirmation. Gold-specific thresholds applied (RSI < 35, VWAP distance < 1%). No short positions ever taken.

indicators.ema_8: Trend direction. Price above EMA(8) = bullish momentum. Below = bearish (no trade — we wait).
indicators.vwap: Session bias. Price above VWAP = buyers in control. Below = sellers (no trade — we wait). Resets at midnight UTC.
indicators.rsi_3: Entry timing. RSI on 3 candles only — extremely sensitive. Below 30 in an uptrend = snap-back setup for a spot buy.
indicators.macd: Trend confirmation. MACD line above signal line confirms bullish momentum before buying.

bias_criteria.neutral_or_bearish: No trade — we do not short sell. We wait for the next halal bullish setup.

long_only: Price is above VWAP — buyers in control for the session
Price is above EMA(8) — uptrend confirmed
RSI(3) has dropped below 30 — short-term pullback in an uptrend, snap-back likely
Price is within 2% of VWAP — not overextended (reduces gharar/excessive uncertainty)
MACD line is above the signal line — momentum confirmed bullish
entry_rules.short: DISABLED — short selling is prohibited under Shariah law (selling what you do not own)

exit_rules: Sell (exit position) when RSI(3) crosses back above 60
Take profit at next VWAP touch or EMA(8) cross (from above)
Never hold a leveraged position — spot only, sell what you own
risk_rules: Risk maximum 1% of portfolio per trade
Maximum trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env
Maximum trades per day capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
Do not trade if price is more than 2% away from VWAP — overextended (gharar risk)
SPOT ONLY — no futures, no margin, no leverage (all involve riba)
NO SHORT SELLING — only buy assets you will own upon execution
Only trade assets on the halal whitelist in bot.js (HALAL_SYMBOLS)
Paper trade first — validate on your specific asset before going live
Calculate and pay zakat (2.5% of the value of holdings) once above nisab for a lunar year (run: node bot.js --zakat)

shariah_notes.on_crypto: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies are considered permissible by many contemporary scholars because they have utility, are not debt instruments, and do not inherently involve interest. Always verify with your own scholar.
shariah_notes.on_trading_fees: Exchange fees are a service charge, not interest (riba), and are generally considered permissible.
shariah_notes.on_zakat: Zakat of 2.5% is due on the market value of trade goods held (not only profit) once above nisab for one full lunar year. Use 'node bot.js --zakat' to get your estimate.
shariah_notes.on_stop_loss: Stop-loss orders are permissible as they protect your owned assets from excessive loss — they are not speculative instruments.
shariah_notes.disclaimer: This bot does not constitute a fatwa. Consult a qualified Islamic scholar for rulings specific to your situation.
